item.title: @anthropic-ai/sdk 1.9.0 (npm) — breaking/deprecated wording
item.description: Quote: A host whose only `tar` or `unzip` is inside those directories can no longer download skills until one is installed outside. Quote: `rg`, and the `tar` and `unzip` that extract skills, no longer get the `ANTHROPIC_*` variables of the process, like the shell of `bash`. Quote: * **api:** deprecate old beta header values Release notes: https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-typescript/releases/tag/sdk-v1.9.0

item.title: anthropic 2.9.0 (pypi) — breaking/deprecated wording
item.description: Quote: The tool no longer runs an `rg` from a relative or empty `PATH` entry or, on Windows, from the current directory. On Windows it looks for `rg.exe`, so an `rg.cmd`, `rg.bat` or `rg.com` is no longer used. With no other `rg` on `PATH`, the tool uses its built-in search. Quote: `rg` no longer gets the `ANTHROPIC_*` variables of the process, like the shell of `bash`. Quote: For a terminated session, the worker now force-stops the work item right after it retrieves the session, before it downloads skills or memory stores. It no longer raises `SessionMemoryError` for such a session. The API reports an archived session as `terminated`. Release notes: https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/releases/tag/v2.9.0
